ItemID: unavailable; Title: Eagles: The Very Best Of; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Familiar classic rock and a greatest-hits format fit my recent listening; I would choose this now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Carole King Tapestry; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its melodic singer-songwriter sound fits my interest in Simon & Garfunkel and Melanie; I would try it.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Best of Bread; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Gentle melodies fit my current mood and interest in older hits; I would choose this.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Sounds of Summer: Very Best of The Beach Boys; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The vocal harmonies and sixties songs appeal after my Beatles and AM Gold listening; I would pick this.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rock sound fits my interest in The Cars, but I would prioritize the compilations this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Definitive Collection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this collection matches my taste.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Carpenters Gold; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic pop appeals, but I would save it for another visit after choosing several albums already.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Best Of Gary Lewis & The Playboys; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The sixties pop fits my AM Gold interest, but it is a lower priority today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Platinum Collection: Greatest Hits I, II & III; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Queen's theatrical pop-rock connects with my classic-rock and Lady Gaga listening, but I would defer this larger collection.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Earth Wind & Fire Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am leaning toward melodic folk-pop and classic rock today, so this funk and soul collection is less appealing right now.
